beforeSources.package.json:
{
  "name": "offlinemask",
  "private": true,
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && pnpm typecheck && vite build && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "tauri": "tauri",
    "typecheck": "vue-tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json",
    "check:native": "cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings",
    "desktop:dev": "tauri dev",
    "desktop:build": "tauri build",
    "test": "node --test tests/*.test.mjs",
    "models:download": "node scripts/prepare-models.mjs --download",
    "models:check": "node scripts/prepare-models.mjs",
    "test:models": "pnpm models:check && node scripts/evaluate-model.mjs",
    "compare:models": "pnpm models:check && node scripts/compare-models.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@huggingface/transformers": "4.2.0",
    "@tauri-apps/api": "^2",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-opener": "^2.5.5",
    "libphonenumber-js": "1.13.12",
    "linkify-it": "6.1.0",
    "openmed": "2.3.0",
    "vue": "^3.5.13"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tauri-apps/cli": "^2",
    "@types/node": "^24",
    "@vitejs/plugin-vue": "^6.0.7",
    "typescript": "~6.0.3",
    "vite": "^8.0.16",
    "vue-tsc": "^3.3.5"
  },
  "description": "Offline desktop workspace for reviewing sensitive data",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.18.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": "^22.12.0 || >=24.0.0",
    "pnpm": "11.18.0"
  }
}
